traditions.KJV: to the custody of Shaashgaz , the king ’s chamberlain , which kept the concubines :

14.english_reference: she came in unto the king no more

traditions.VUL: nec habébat potestátem ad regem ultra redeúndi ,
traditions.KJV: she came in unto the king no more ,

traditions.VUL: Evolúto autem témpore per órdinem , instábat dies , quo Esther fília Abíhail fratris Mardochǽi , quam sibi adoptáverat in fíliam , debéret intráre ad regem .
traditions.KJV: Now when the turn of Esther , the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai , who had taken her for his daughter , was come to go in unto the king ,

traditions.KJV: she required nothing but what Hegai the king ’s chamberlain , the keeper of the women , appointed .

traditions.KJV: And Esther obtained favour in the sight of all them that looked upon her .

traditions.VUL: Ducta est ítaque ad cubículum regis Assuéri mense décimo ,
traditions.KJV: So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month ,

traditions.VUL: séptimo anno regni eius .
traditions.KJV: in the seventh year of his reign .

traditions.VUL: Et adamávit eam rex plus quam omnes mulíeres ,
traditions.KJV: And the king loved Esther above all the women ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ εὗρεν χάριν παρὰ πάσας τὰς παρθένους ,
traditions.VUL: habuítque grátiam et misericórdiam coram eo super omnes mulíeres ,
traditions.KJV: and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins ;

17.english_reference: so that he set the royal crown upon her head

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֤שֶׂם כֶּֽתֶר מַלְכוּת֙ בְּ רֹאשָׁ֔ הּ

traditions.KJV: and gave gifts , according to the state of the king .

traditions.KJV: then Mordecai sat in the king ’s gate .

traditions.KJV: And when inquisition was made of the matter , it was found out ;

traditions.VUL: Mandatúmque est históriis , et annálibus tráditum coram rege .
traditions.KJV: and it was written in the book of the chronicles before the king .
